title: The Korean Store Where Nothing Costs More Than $4

slides.headline: Nothing in Korea's favorite store **costs more than $4.**
slides.note: Tourists plan whole afternoons around it. Koreans just call it Daiso (다이소).

slides.headline: Six prices. **That is it.**
slides.body: 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 3,000 or 5,000 won. No 4,990-won tricks. The top price is about US$4.

slides.headline: Small fixes **for small homes**
slides.body: Drawer dividers, door hooks, fridge bins, shoe racks. Korean apartments are compact, and Daiso sells the parts that make them work.

slides.headline: Then the skincare **started selling out**
slides.body: Since 2023, real K-beauty brands have made cheap Daiso-only lines. VT's Reedle Shot kept vanishing from shelves.

slides.headline: stores **across Korea**
slides.body: The nationwide count in 2024. In Seoul you rarely walk far to find one.

slides.headline: It is **fully Korean now**
slides.body: It grew up with a Japanese Daiso partner. In 2023 its Korean owner Asung bought out the Japanese stake.

slides.headline: Not your **last-resort dollar store**
slides.body: In many countries a dollar store is where you go when you have to. Here people go on purpose, and stay an hour.

slides.headline: The word is **gasseongbi (가성비)**
slides.body: Value for money. Koreans judge everything by it, from lunch to laptops. Daiso is that word turned into a store.

slides.headline: A 5,000-won ceiling, **a whole afternoon**
slides.body: The Myeongdong branch has 12 floors. Add Olive Young down the street and that is the K-shopping route.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: A neat fan of small editorial photo cards on a dark tabletop.

caption:
Nothing in Daiso, Korea's favorite everyday store, costs more than 5,000 won, about US$4. There are six price points and that is the whole menu.

Koreans go for the small fixes that make compact apartments work: drawer dividers, door hooks, fridge bins. Since 2023 real K-beauty brands have made cheap Daiso-only skincare, and some of it keeps selling out. The Myeongdong branch has 12 floors, and for a lot of visitors it is now half of the standard shopping route, next to Olive Young.

What store in your country do you walk into for one thing and leave with ten?
reply: One number behind all those storage boxes: in 2024, 36.1% of Korean households were one person living alone, the most common household type in the country. Small homes, small budgets, small fixes. What does your country's go-to cheap store look like?

gasseongbi (가성비)는 가격 대비 성능·가치에 관한 한국어 일상 표현. 문화적 맥락 설명으로 사용.
reply의 1인가구 36.1%(2024)는 통계청 자료. 'most common household type'은 1인가구가 가구원수별 최다 유형이라는 뜻.
'No 4,990-won tricks'는 정찰 가격대 운영에서 나온 서술(끝자리 가격 없음).
